title: Design: the toast after a split names the new work order and the tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with two labor lines, line 2 holding a part in category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Split Work Order in the work order's three-dot menu.
  3. Tick line 2.
  4. Click Split.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Split Work Order opens.

Step 3:

  • Line 2 is ticked.

Step 4:

  • The new work order opens and a toast reads its number, "created from" and work order 1's number.
  • Its second line reads "1 parts moved, priced by" or "1 part moved, priced by" with tier A's name, in the form of picture 11.5.
